title: Funding event
description: A round of funding. A part that competitor-funding composes at round; a listener for funding-event@^1 hears the round of every competitor-funding signal, which is how a frame watches the market's rounds without naming a company.

cases.note: It projects nothing by itself; the composite competitor-funding folds it into a competitor's record, and edge listeners (propose, revalidate) hear it directly.

note: Open type in the competitors package (the implicit library naive).
